records.translation: :func:`scan_tiles` **只读取文件头**。``.npy`` 通过 :func:`numpy.lib.format.read_magic` 加上公开的 ``read_array_header_*`` 函数对读取；TIFF 通过 ``tifffile.TiffFile`` 的序列元数据读取。一千个图块只需一千次 ``seek``\ s，不读取任何像素。

records.context: :func:`estimate_offsets` registers pairs on the **overlap strip only**, read out of a memory-mapped microscope image field through the same windowed access pattern :class:`spacr.crops.MergedField` uses for on-demand extracted image regions. A 10% overlap on a 2048x2048 microscope image field is a 2048x205 strip — 0.8 MB, not 8 MB.
records.label: spacr.align#3

records.source: :func:`estimate_offsets` registers pairs on the **overlap strip only**, read out of a memory-mapped tile through the same windowed access pattern :class:`spacr.crops.MergedField` uses for on-demand crops. A 10% overlap on a 2048x2048 tile is a 2048x205 strip — 0.8 MB, not 8 MB.
records.translation: :func:`estimate_offsets` **只在重叠条带上**配准图块对，条带从内存映射的图块中读出，采用与 :class:`spacr.crops.MergedField` 按需裁剪相同的窗口访问模式。2048x2048 图块上 10% 的重叠是一个 2048x205 的条带——0.8 MB，而不是 8 MB。

records.context: The module also records, per microscope image field, whether it was placed by registration or fell back to its nominal position.
records.label: spacr.align#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The module also records, per tile, whether it was placed by registration or fell back to its nominal position.
records.translation: 本模块还会逐个图块记录其是通过配准放置的，还是回退到了名义位置。

records.context: **A pair that does not register is reported, not guessed.** Phase correlation over a blank or near-empty overlap returns a confident-looking peak that is pure noise. Every pair is therefore scored by the normalised cross-correlation of the two strips *after* the measured shift is applied; below ``min_confidence`` the pair is dropped, and a microscope image field left with no surviving pair keeps its nominal stage position and is marked ``method='nominal'``. A nominally-placed microscope image field is not the same thing as a registered one and :data:`ALIGN_TABLE` says which is which, per microscope image field.
records.label: spacr.align#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A pair that does not register is reported, not guessed.** Phase correlation over a blank or near-empty overlap returns a confident-looking peak that is pure noise. Every pair is therefore scored by the normalised cross-correlation of the two strips *after* the measured shift is applied; below ``min_confidence`` the pair is dropped, and a tile left with no surviving pair keeps its nominal stage position and is marked ``method='nominal'``. A nominally-placed tile is not the same thing as a registered one and :data:`ALIGN_TABLE` says which is which, per tile.
records.translation: **未能配准的图块对会被报告，而不是靠猜测。** 在空白或近乎空白的重叠区域上，相位相关会返回一个看似可信、实则纯属噪声的峰值。因此，每个图块对都在应用测得的位移*之后*，以两个条带的归一化互相关进行评分；低于 ``min_confidence`` 的图块对会被丢弃，没有任何保留图块对的图块保持其名义载物台位置，并标记为 ``method='nominal'``。按名义位置放置的图块与经过配准的图块并不相同，:data:`ALIGN_TABLE` 会逐个图块说明哪个是哪个。

records.context: **Image data channels share one solution.** Registration runs on ``reference_channel`` alone and the resulting placement is applied to every image data channel of that site. Aligning image data channels independently would shear the composite — a nucleus mask and its own DAPI image data channel would no longer line up — so it is not offered.
records.label: spacr.align#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Channels share one solution.** Registration runs on ``reference_channel`` alone and the resulting placement is applied to every channel of that site. Aligning channels independently would shear the composite — a nucleus mask and its own DAPI channel would no longer line up — so it is not offered.
records.translation: **各通道共用一个解。** 配准只在 ``reference_channel`` 上运行，得到的放置结果应用于该位点的每个通道。各通道独立对齐会使合成图像发生错切——细胞核掩膜与其自身的 DAPI 通道将不再对齐——因此不提供这一选项。

records.context: **Why accumulation fails.** Adding every measured shift to the previous position gives ``p_k = sum(d_0..d_k)`` and carries each measurement error forward. Ten tiles with 0.3 px errors place the last tile 3 px away from its correct position. Least squares distributes errors across *identical input measurements*. A real grid has redundant edges, including the tile below, the tile to the right, and the ``i``/``i+2`` pairs in a heavily overlapped row. Their disagreements can cancel instead of accumulating. The returned per-tile residual records the remaining disagreement.
records.label: spacr.align.solve_positions#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Why not accumulate.** Walking a row and adding each measured shift to the previous position gives ``p_k = sum(d_0..d_k)``, so every measurement error is carried forward: ten tiles with 0.3 px errors put the last one 3 px out, and nothing in the output says so. Least squares over the *same* measurements distributes the error instead — and because a real grid has redundant edges (the tile below as well as the tile to the right, or the ``i``/``i+2`` pairs of a heavily overlapped row), disagreements cancel rather than compound. The surviving disagreement is the per-tile residual, which is returned.
records.translation: **为什么不累加。** 沿一行逐个将测得的位移加到前一个位置上，得到 ``p_k = sum(d_0..d_k)``，因此每个测量误差都会向前传递：十个各有 0.3 px 误差的图块会让最后一个偏离 3 px，而输出中没有任何提示。对*同样的*测量值做最小二乘则会分摊误差——而且由于真实网格有冗余的边（下方的图块和右侧的图块，或高度重叠行中的 ``i``/``i+2`` 图块对），不一致会相互抵消而不是叠加。剩余的不一致就是每个图块的残差，会一并返回。

records.translation: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` 删除任何包含 NaN 的特征列。在真实数据库中，它通常会删除所有 ``pathogen_*`` 列，因为对没有病原体的细胞而言这些列为 NaN。``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` 删除任何包含 NaN 的对象行。出于同样的原因，通常会删除几乎所有内容；之所以提供，是因为在单一对象类型的导出中它往往恰好合适。``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` 进行插补。两者默认都会写出一个形状相同的 ``layers['missing']`` 布尔掩膜，使插补值能与测量值区分开；布尔掩膜每个单元格占 1 字节，而默认的 ``float32`` ``X`` 每个单元格占 4 字节。

records.context: **Infinities are treated as missing under every policy.** spaCR produces +/-inf from ratio features (a denominator of zero), and an inf survives ``dropna`` while destroying any scaling, PCA or distance computed from it. They are converted to NaN before the policy runs and counted separately in ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']`` so the substitution is never silent.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#16
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Infinities are treated as missing under every policy.** spaCR produces +/-inf from ratio features (a denominator of zero), and an inf survives ``dropna`` while destroying any scaling, PCA or distance computed from it. They are converted to NaN before the policy runs and counted separately in ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']`` so the substitution is never silent.
records.translation: **在每种策略下，无穷值都被视为缺失。** spaCR 会从比值特征（分母为零）产生 +/-inf，而 inf 能逃过 ``dropna``，却会破坏基于它计算的任何缩放、PCA 或距离。它们会在策略运行之前被转换为 NaN，并单独计入 ``uns['spacr']['nan']['n_infinite']``，因此这种替换绝不是静默的。

records.context: :func:`spacr.io._read_and_join_tables` takes six named columns off ``png_list`` -- the object id, ``png_path`` and the four microscope field of view structured-data names -- and drops the rest. The rest is every annotation column the Annotate app added and every score the machine-learning classification model wrote, which for this export are among the most valuable columns in the database: without them ``obs`` has no label to train on, group by, or colour a UMAP with. They are re-attached by object identifier (:func:`_attach_png_labels`) *before* filtering, so a filter can name one -- "export the cells I annotated as infected" -- and they are separated into ``uns['spacr']['annotation_columns']`` and ``uns['spacr']['prediction_columns']`` using :mod:`spacr.agreement`'s own rule, which exists because a model's class column is indistinguishable *by shape* from an annotation pass.

records.translation: :func:`spacr.io._read_and_join_tables` 从 ``png_list`` 中取出六个指定列——对象 id、``png_path`` 和四个视野键——并丢弃其余列。其余的列包括 Annotate 应用添加的每个注释列和分类器写入的每个得分，对于本导出而言，它们是数据库中最有价值的列之一：没有它们，``obs`` 就没有可用于训练、分组或为 UMAP 着色的标签。它们会在过滤*之前*按对象键重新附加（:func:`_attach_png_labels`），使过滤条件可以引用它们——"export the cells I annotated as infected"（导出我标注为已感染的细胞）——并分别放入 ``uns['spacr']['annotation_columns']`` 和 ``uns['spacr']['prediction_columns']``，所依据的是 :mod:`spacr.agreement` 自身的规则；之所以需要该规则，是因为模型的类别列在*形式上*与一次注释无法区分。

records.translation: ``obs_names`` 使用 :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys`，作用于 :data:`spacr.selection.OBJECT_KEY_COLUMNS`——即模式自身的行键（``plateID``、``rowID``、``columnID``、``fieldID``、``object_label``），用 :data:`spacr.schema.KEY_SEPARATOR` 连接。来自 UMAP 套索选择的键在导出的 ``.h5ad`` 中指向同一个对象。``X`` / ``obs`` 按 :func:`spacr.schema.is_provenance_column` 划分，这正是 :mod:`spacr.feature_dict` 和每条模型路径已在使用的边界，另外还结合了 :mod:`spacr.agreement` 对哪些列由*模型*写入、哪些由*人*写入的判断。``var`` 使用 :func:`spacr.feature_dict.parse_column`，并依据该行自身的 ``measurement_units`` 解析，因此 3-D 运行的 ``cell_area`` 会被记录为它实际表示的体积，而不是其名称所示的面积。筛选使用 :class:`spacr.selection.DataFilter` 和 :class:`spacr.selection.Selection`——与 GUI 联动视图发布的对象相同，因此 "export what I am looking at"（导出我正在查看的内容）只需一次调用，而不需要第二种过滤语言。

records.context: a measurement row. records.source: a measurement row. The label is the first present of ``object_label``, ``label``, ``cell_id``, ``nucleus_id``, ``pathogen_id``, ``cytoplasm_id``, and a row with none of them raises :class:`CropError`; ``object_type``, if present, overrides the template spec's. ``bbox-0`` .. ``bbox-3`` (or ``bbox_0`` .. ``bbox_3``) are honoured only when all four are there, and are reordered out of the skimage ``regionprops`` convention ``(min_row, min_col, max_row, max_col)`` into the spec's ``(y0, y1, x0, x1)`` -- supplying them lets the crop skip the whole-plane label index scan. The mask plane inside that box is still read, unless the spec also sets ``use_bounding_box``, which skips reading the label plane altogether.
records.translation: 一条测量行。标签取 ``object_label``、``label``、``cell_id``、``nucleus_id``、``pathogen_id``、``cytoplasm_id`` 中第一个存在的值，全都没有的行会引发 :class:`CropError`；如果存在 ``object_type``，则覆盖模板规格中的值。``bbox-0`` .. ``bbox-3``（或 ``bbox_0`` .. ``bbox_3``）只有在四个都存在时才会采用，并会从 skimage ``regionprops`` 约定 ``(min_row, min_col, max_row, max_col)`` 重新排列为规格的 ``(y0, y1, x0, x1)``——提供它们可以让裁剪跳过整个平面的标签索引扫描。框内的掩膜平面仍会被读取，除非规格还设置了 ``use_bounding_box``，此时会完全跳过读取标签平面。

records.context: Their measurements are always written to ``foreign_<object>``. The canonical ``cell`` / ``nucleus`` / ``pathogen`` tables are spaCR's, and :func:`run_import` writes one only when it is empty of anyone else's work — either because the destination is a fresh project (an import-only project needs a ``cell`` table for the rest of spaCR to read, and gets a copy of the foreign rows) or because a previous processing session of *this* importer wrote it and it has not been added to since.
records.label: spacr.foreign#9

records.source: Their measurements are always written to ``foreign_<object>``. records.translation: 他们的测量结果始终写入 ``foreign_<object>``。规范的 ``cell`` / ``nucleus`` / ``pathogen`` 表属于 spaCR，:func:`run_import` 只有在表中没有他人工作成果时才会写入其中一个——要么因为目标是全新项目（仅导入的项目需要一个 ``cell`` 表供 spaCR 其他部分读取，并会得到外部行的一份副本），要么因为该表是*本*导入器之前的运行写入的，且此后未被追加过。

records.translation: 按位置记录哪个通道标记对应哪个通道列：``channel_tokens[i]`` 是列 ``i`` 所代表的标记。表格保存这一信息，是因为它要经过多次拖放才填满。把 ``C1``/``C2`` 变成第 0 列和第 1 列的排序是一组标记的属性，而用户每次只填一个视野，因此若不保存标记，第二次拖放会从头对自己的文件排序，把 ``C2`` 放到第 0 列，与第一次拖放的 ``C1`` 并列。为空表示目前没有任何列对应特定标记——每个单元格都是通过浏览而不是正则表达式填入的。

records.translation: 排序针对的是整个表格的标记集合，而不是单次拖放。``table`` 在 :attr:`FieldTable.channel_tokens` 中保存哪个标记对应哪一列，之后的拖放会基于其新带来的标记与已有标记的并集进行排序。如果某个标记排在已放置的标记之前，就会重新编号各列并移动其中已有的文件（:func:`_renumber_channels`），从而让每一行对通道 0 的含义保持一致。若每次拖放单独排序，第二个视野的 ``C2`` 会被放到第 0 列，与第一个视野的 ``C1`` 并列，而唯一的迹象只会出现在数据库中。

records.source: It used to cast to ``float32``, normalise into 0-255 and then ``np.clip(crop, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)``. With ``normalize=False`` that clip hit every 16-bit pixel brighter than 255 -- i.e. the whole object -- so the PNG written to disk was a solid white silhouette. The datasets built from it were trained on saturated images and nothing said so.
records.translation: 过去它会转换为 ``float32``，归一化到 0-255，然后执行 ``np.clip(crop, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)``。在 ``normalize=False`` 时，这一截断会作用于每个亮于 255 的 16 位像素——也就是整个对象——因此写入磁盘的 PNG 是一个纯白剪影。由此构建的数据集是用饱和图像训练的，而没有任何提示。

records.context: ``src`` (str or list) — one or more plate or ``…/merged`` folders, each measured in turn into its own ``measurements`` folder. records.context: Timelapse live preview — segment once, re-link live.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#0
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Timelapse live preview — segment once, re-link live.
records.translation: Timelapse 实时预览——分割一次，实时重新链接。

records.context: Timelapse first generates masks for a time series and then links adjacent frames. The costs differ greatly: segmenting twelve frames with Cellpose takes tens of seconds, while relinking *the twelve existing label images* with a new ``timelapse_displacement`` takes milliseconds. The preview separates these stages so a slider change does not rerun segmentation:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The Timelapse module is mask generation over a time series followed by frame-to-frame linking. Those two halves cost wildly different amounts: segmenting twelve frames with Cellpose is tens of seconds, re-linking the *same* twelve label images with a new ``timelapse_displacement`` is milliseconds. A preview that re-segments on every slider move is unusable, so this panel splits them:
records.translation: Timelapse 模块先对时间序列生成掩膜，再进行帧间链接。这两部分的开销相差悬殊：用 Cellpose 分割十二帧需要数十秒，而用新的 ``timelapse_displacement`` 重新链接*同样的*十二幅标签图像只需几毫秒。每次移动滑块都重新分割的预览无法使用，因此本面板将两者分开：

records.context: **The sequence is read lazily.** :class:`FrameSequence` never materialises the whole time series: a directory reads one file at a time, a multi-page TIFF reads one page at a time, and an ``.npy`` stack is memory-mapped and sliced. Only the frames the preview actually shows are touched, and a small LRU keeps the scrubber responsive without pinning the movie in RAM.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The sequence is read lazily.** :class:`FrameSequence` never materialises the whole time series: a directory reads one file at a time, a multi-page TIFF reads one page at a time, and an ``.npy`` stack is memory-mapped and sliced. Only the frames the preview actually shows are touched, and a small LRU keeps the scrubber responsive without pinning the movie in RAM.
records.translation: **序列采用延迟读取。** :class:`FrameSequence` 从不将整个时间序列载入内存：目录每次读取一个文件，多页 TIFF 每次读取一页，``.npy`` 堆栈则进行内存映射并切片。只有预览实际显示的帧才会被读取，一个小型 LRU 缓存可以让拖动条保持响应，而不会把整部影片驻留在 RAM 中。

records.context: What the panel *shows* is chosen around the two failure modes people actually tune a tracker against:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What the panel *shows* is chosen around the two failure modes people actually tune a tracker against:
records.translation: 面板*显示*的内容，是围绕人们调节追踪器时实际要应对的两种失败模式来选择的：

records.context: **Fragmentation** — one object becoming several track ids. Surfaced as track count, mean/median track length, the number of tracks shorter than a live-settable N, and the count of tracks that start after the first frame or end before the last one.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Fragmentation** — one object becoming several track ids. Surfaced as track count, mean/median track length, the number of tracks shorter than a live-settable N, and the count of tracks that start after the first frame or end before the last one.
records.translation: **碎片化**——一个对象变成多个轨迹 id。以轨迹数量、平均/中位轨迹长度、短于可实时设置的 N 的轨迹数量，以及在第一帧之后开始或在最后一帧之前结束的轨迹数量来呈现。

records.context: **Identity swaps** — a track jumping to a different object. Surfaced as the number of within-track steps longer than the displacement limit the user is tuning, plus the largest single step. Masks are relabelled *by track id* and drawn in a per-track colour, so a swap is visible as an object changing colour mid-movie.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Identity swaps** — a track jumping to a different object. Surfaced as the number of within-track steps longer than the displacement limit the user is tuning, plus the largest single step. Masks are relabelled *by track id* and drawn in a per-track colour, so a swap is visible as an object changing colour mid-movie.
records.translation: **身份交换**——一条轨迹跳到另一个对象上。以轨迹内步长超过用户正在调节的位移上限的次数，以及最大的单步位移来呈现。掩膜会*按轨迹 id* 重新标记，并以每条轨迹各自的颜色绘制，因此交换表现为对象在影片中途改变颜色。

records.context: whether the jobs run off the main GUI execution path. Opening a sequence reads a TIFF header or memory-maps a stack and then lists every sibling microscope field of view, which is not main GUI execution path work on a laboratory microplate. False runs each job inline, emitting the same signals in the same order, so a test can drive this panel synchronously without the behaviour diverging.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview.TimelapsePreviewPanel#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: whether the jobs run off the GUI thread. Opening a sequence reads a TIFF header or memory-maps a stack and then lists every sibling field of view, which is not GUI-thread work on a plate. False runs each job inline, emitting the same signals in the same order, so a test can drive this panel synchronously without the behaviour diverging.

records.context: This is the GUI entry point; :meth:`load_masks` opens the sequence inline. ``FrameSequence.open`` on a folder of label images is a stat, a listing and one ``is_file()`` per entry -- hundreds of round trips for a plate -- and the folder comes from the user, so it can be a sleeping ``/nas_mnt`` share where a single stat was measured not to return within twenty seconds (see :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`). On the GUI thread that would freeze the window after the file dialog closes.
records.translation: 这是 GUI 入口；:meth:`load_masks` 以内联方式打开序列。对一个标签图像文件夹执行 ``FrameSequence.open``，需要一次 stat、一次列目录，以及对每个条目调用一次 ``is_file()``——对一块板而言就是数百次往返——而且文件夹由用户提供，因此它可能是一个处于休眠状态的 ``/nas_mnt`` 共享，曾测得单次 stat 在二十秒内都没有返回（参见 :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`）。如果在 GUI 线程上执行，文件对话框关闭后窗口就会冻结。

records.source: The module provides three things for a pipeline run:
records.translation: 本模块为流程运行提供三样东西：

records.context: **One processing-session id, on every log line and every output.** :func:`run_context` mints one id, stamps it onto every :class:`logging.LogRecord` created anywhere in the process, writes a per processing session JSONL log that :func:`read_run_log` reads back, and hands the *same* id to :func:`spacr.artifacts.register_run_outputs`. A log line and an output can therefore be joined on ``run_id``, so every log record of the processing session that produced a given file can be retrieved.
records.label: spacr.runctx#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **One run id, on every log line and every output.** :func:`run_context` mints one id, stamps it onto every :class:`logging.LogRecord` created anywhere in the process, writes a per-run JSONL log that :func:`read_run_log` reads back, and hands the *same* id to :func:`spacr.artifacts.register_run_outputs`. A log line and an output can therefore be joined on ``run_id``, so every log record of the run that produced a given file can be retrieved.
records.translation: **每条日志行和每个输出都带同一个运行 id。** :func:`run_context` 生成一个 id，将其写入进程中任何位置创建的每个 :class:`logging.LogRecord`，写出一个可由 :func:`read_run_log` 读回的逐运行 JSONL 日志，并把*同一个* id 交给 :func:`spacr.artifacts.register_run_outputs`。因此日志行和输出可以按 ``run_id`` 连接，从而可以检索生成某个文件的那次运行的所有日志记录。

records.context: **One error policy, honoured at every batch boundary.** ``on_error`` is a tri-state, default ``"stop"``:
records.label: spacr.runctx#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **One error policy, honoured at every batch boundary.** ``on_error`` is a tri-state, default ``"stop"``:
records.translation: **一种错误策略，在每个批次边界都得到遵守。** ``on_error`` 是三态值，默认为 ``"stop"``：

records.context: ``stop`` the first failed unit aborts the processing session. The default, because a workflow that quietly drops a third of its plates produces a number that looks exactly like a good one. ``skip`` the unit is recorded — on the :class:`~spacr.errors.RunLedger` *and* as a :class:`SkipRecord` naming the unit, the stage and why — and the processing session carries on. Never a silent drop: :attr:`ErrorPolicy.skips` is what was lost. ``retry`` the unit is attempted :attr:`ErrorPolicy.attempts` times with an exponential backoff, and if the budget runs out it behaves exactly like ``stop``.
records.label: spacr.runctx#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``stop`` the first failed unit aborts the run. The default, because a pipeline that quietly drops a third of its plates produces a number that looks exactly like a good one. ``skip`` the unit is recorded — on the :class:`~spacr.errors.RunLedger` *and* as a :class:`SkipRecord` naming the unit, the stage and why — and the run carries on. Never a silent drop: :attr:`ErrorPolicy.skips` is what was lost. ``retry`` the unit is attempted :attr:`ErrorPolicy.attempts` times with an exponential backoff, and if the budget runs out it behaves exactly like ``stop``.
records.translation: ``stop`` 第一个失败的单元会中止运行。这是默认值，因为悄悄丢掉三分之一板的流程产生的数字看起来与正常结果一模一样。``skip`` 该单元会被记录——记录在 :class:`~spacr.errors.RunLedger` 上，*同时*作为一条指明单元、阶段和原因的 :class:`SkipRecord`——然后运行继续。绝不会静默丢弃：:attr:`ErrorPolicy.skips` 就是丢失的内容。``retry`` 该单元会以指数退避尝试 :attr:`ErrorPolicy.attempts` 次，如果次数用完，其行为与 ``stop`` 完全相同。

records.context: **What this does not buy you.** A seed makes the *draws* reproducible. It does not make CUDA reductions associative, it does not stop a forked worker pool from sharing one stream, and it cannot re-seed this interpreter's string hashing. Every such limit is named in :attr:`SeedReport.caveats` and in :data:`SEED_CAVEATS`; do not promise a user more than that list allows. In particular, calling this and then reporting "the run is deterministic" is wrong on a GPU unless ``deterministic=True`` *and* the model avoids the kernels Torch has no deterministic implementation for.
records.label: spacr.runctx.seed_everything#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **What this does not buy you.** A seed makes the *draws* reproducible. It does not make CUDA reductions associative, it does not stop a forked worker pool from sharing one stream, and it cannot re-seed this interpreter's string hashing. Every such limit is named in :attr:`SeedReport.caveats` and in :data:`SEED_CAVEATS`; do not promise a user more than that list allows. In particular, calling this and then reporting "the run is deterministic" is wrong on a GPU unless ``deterministic=True`` *and* the model avoids the kernels Torch has no deterministic implementation for.
records.translation: **这不能为你保证什么。** 种子使*抽样*可复现。它不能使 CUDA 归约满足结合律，不能阻止 fork 出的工作进程池共享同一个流，也无法为当前解释器的字符串哈希重新设置种子。每一项此类限制都在 :attr:`SeedReport.caveats` 和 :data:`SEED_CAVEATS` 中列明；不要向用户承诺超出该列表允许范围的内容。特别是，在 GPU 上调用此函数后就报告 "the run is deterministic"（运行是确定性的）是错误的，除非 ``deterministic=True`` *并且*模型避开了 Torch 没有确定性实现的那些内核。

records.translation: 这两个模块用不同的说法做着同样的事。在 78 个 CV 设置和 37 个 ML 设置中，有六个名称相同——而这六个中有两个的默认值不一致（``annotation_column`` 在一个模块中为 ``'test'``，在另一个中为 ``None``；``n_jobs`` 分别为 28 和 -1）。另有三对是名称不同的同一设置。因此设置 CSV 无法在两者之间通用，用户的理解也无法通用。

records.context: **The training basis.** Classify (CV) already had all three: ``dataset_mode`` is ``'metadata'``, ``'annotation'`` or ``'measurement'``, and :mod:`spacr.io` builds the dataset from ``class_metadata``/``metadata_rules``, ``annotation_columns``/``annotation_values`` accordingly. Classify (ML) had two, and chose between them **implicitly**: ``ml.py`` asked whether ``annotation_column`` was ``None``. Nothing said so in the settings panel, so a user who filled in an annotation column silently stopped training on their laboratory microplate controls.

records.translation: **训练基础。** Classify (CV) 已经具备全部三种：``dataset_mode`` 为 ``'metadata'``、``'annotation'`` 或 ``'measurement'``，:mod:`spacr.io` 相应地根据 ``class_metadata``/``metadata_rules``、``annotation_columns``/``annotation_values`` 构建数据集。Classify (ML) 只有两种，并且是**隐式地**在两者之间选择：``ml.py`` 判断 ``annotation_column`` 是否为 ``None``。设置面板中对此没有任何说明，因此填写了注释列的用户会在不知情的情况下不再使用其板对照进行训练。

records.context: **Backward compatibility.** A settings CSV written before this exists in every user's project folder, and, as INVARIANTS §6 records, a structured-data name *absent* from the key-value mapping means the workflow falls back to its own default, which can differ from the GUI's, and nothing says so. Every rename here is therefore an alias, not a replacement — :func:`normalize_settings` translates the old name and the old *implicit* basis into the new explicit one, and a processing session from an old CSV does exactly what it did before.
records.label: spacr.training_basis#4

records.source: **Backward compatibility.** A settings CSV written before this exists in every user's project folder, and, as INVARIANTS §6 records, a key *absent* from the dict means the pipeline falls back to its own default, which can differ from the GUI's, and nothing says so. Every rename here is therefore an alias, not a replacement — :func:`normalize_settings` translates the old name and the old *implicit* basis into the new explicit one, and a run from an old CSV does exactly what it did before.
records.translation: **向后兼容。** 在此之前写出的设置 CSV 存在于每个用户的项目文件夹中，而且正如 INVARIANTS §6 所记录的，字典中*缺少*某个键意味着流程会回退到其自身的默认值，该默认值可能与 GUI 的不同，且不会有任何提示。因此这里的每次重命名都是别名，而不是替换——:func:`normalize_settings` 会把旧名称和旧的*隐式*训练基础转换为新的显式形式，用旧 CSV 进行的运行与以前完全相同。
